Treatment failure or complication at 1 y.span: In the antibiotics group, 29% had undergone appendectomy by 90 days. Complications were more common in the antibiotics group than in the appendectomy group (8.1 vs. 3.5 per 100 participants; rate ratio, 2.28).
Treatment failure or complication at 1 y.why: The abstract reports appendectomy-by-90-days and complications through 90 days, not a composite of treatment failure or complication at 1 year; the trials primary is 30-day EQ-5D health status.
